props.label: Sec
props.html:
Local painters, Hunters Hill peninsula

Repaints built for a heritage peninsula between two rivers

Hunters Hill is not a paint-and-run kind of place. Most of the municipality sits inside a conservation area, and the homes show it: sandstone villas, Federation weatherboards, deep timber verandahs and rendered facades that have weathered a century of river air. Paint that suits here has to respect the building and hold up to the salt and humidity coming off the Lane Cove and Parramatta Rivers.

That is the work we do. Sydney Paintmasters has spent 20+ years painting homes and businesses across Sydney, and on the Hunters Hill peninsula we lean into careful prep, mould-resistant coatings and colours that sit right on older joinery. We turn up when we say we will. We protect your garden, your floors and your foreshore views. And we leave the site clean.

Whether it's a full exterior on a foreshore home in Woolwich, a tidy interior refresh in Gladesville, or strata work on a riverside block, you get one team, one fixed price, and a finish that lasts. No call-out fee. Free quote. Easy to reach.

What we paint

Painter services across Hunters Hill

Full-service house and commercial painting for the peninsula, plus three things this area genuinely needs that most painters skip over. The highlighted cards are our Hunters Hill specialties.

Hunters Hill Specialty

Heritage house painting Hunters Hill

Sandstone villas, Federation homes and Victorian-era cottages. We prep gently, restore tired timber, and match period-appropriate colours so the repaint reads true to the house, not painted over it.

Hunters Hill Specialty

Waterfront exterior painting Hunters Hill

Foreshore and riverside homes cop salt-laden air, humidity and hard UV. We use mould-resistant, weather-rated coatings and proper surface prep built for the Lane Cove and Parramatta River fronts.

Hunters Hill Specialty

Timber and detail restoration Hunters Hill

Verandahs, fretwork, French doors, window frames and eaves. The decorative joinery that defines Hunters Hill and Woolwich needs careful sanding, filling and finishing. That’s exactly where we slow down.

Whole-home repaints inside and out, planned around your family and finished on schedule.

Walls, ceilings, trim and feature rooms. Low-odour finishes and dust control so you can keep living in the house.

Weatherboard, render, brick and fibro. Prep-first exteriors that stand up to river weather and shade.

Roof painting Hunters Hill

props.label: Areas
props.html:
Suburb by suburb

Painters across the Hunters Hill suburbs

We cover the whole peninsula. Here is what a typical job looks like in each of the main pockets, and where each one sits.

Gladesville 2111

Painters in Gladesville

Gladesville is the largest and busiest of our local suburbs, full of professional homeowners looking after riverside houses and investment properties. Stock is a real mix here: Federation homes, solid interwar brick, and units near the Victoria Road shopping strip. A lot of our Gladesville work is full repaints and between-tenant refreshes booked around busy household schedules.

Typical job: a three-bed interwar home off the shops, walls and ceilings inside, timber windows and eaves prepped and recoated outside, done over a working week.
Get a Gladesville quote →
Woolwich 2110

Painters in Woolwich

Woolwich sits out on the heritage peninsula around Woolwich Dock and Kelly’s Bush, and the homes are premium: prestige waterfront houses with rendered and timber facades that face the weather head on. This is careful, patient exterior work. We spend real time on surface prep and older joinery, then finish in durable coatings that cope with salt air and full sun.

Typical job: a waterfront home exterior, render made good and recoated, timber windows and a period front door restored, colours kept sympathetic to the street.
Get a Woolwich quote →
Henley & Huntleys Cove 2111

Painters in Henley and Huntleys Cove

Henley is a small, quiet riverside pocket where weatherboard Federation homes take the brunt of waterside weathering, so exterior prep and a hard-wearing finish matter most. Huntleys Cove, just along the peninsula, mixes Federation and interwar houses with rendered and timber exteriors that we tend to repaint as full-home jobs. Both are calm streets, and we work them cleanly and quietly.

Typical job: a weatherboard Henley cottage stripped back where needed and recoated, or a Huntleys Cove home refreshed inside and out in one booking.
Get a quote for your street →
Hunters Hill 2110

Painters in Hunters Hill village

The Hunters Hill core is the heart of the conservation area: sandstone, stone walls, mature trees and some of the peninsula’s finest heritage homes. Work here is detail-led and colour-sensitive, from grand exteriors to careful interiors. We also cover Huntleys Point, the small residential point off the Gladesville side, on request. If your street is on the peninsula, we paint it.

Typical job: a heritage exterior on a leafy Hunters Hill street, gentle prep on render and stone-adjacent timber, colours checked against the streetscape before a brush is loaded.
Get a Hunters Hill quote →

props.label: Faq
props.html:
Answers

Hunters Hill painting FAQs

The questions we hear most from peninsula homeowners and managers.

How much does a painter cost in Hunters Hill?
Repaints here are quoted per job, not per hour. A single room is usually in the low hundreds, while a full interior or a heritage exterior costs more and depends on prep, access and surface condition. Every quote is free with no call-out fee, and the fixed price is locked in before we start. Call 0423 019 087 for a same-week measure-up.
Do you paint heritage and Federation homes?
Yes, that’s core work for us on this peninsula. We handle sandstone-adjacent timber, Federation weatherboard, decorative fretwork and period joinery with gentle prep and colours chosen to suit the era of the house. We keep finishes sympathetic to the streetscape, and we won’t claim heritage approvals we don’t hold.
Can you paint waterfront and foreshore homes exposed to salt air?
Yes. Homes along the Lane Cove and Parramatta Rivers cop humidity, salt-laden air and strong UV. We prep thoroughly and use mould-resistant, weather-rated coatings suited to render, timber, masonry and sandstone so the finish lasts in those conditions.
What suburbs around Hunters Hill do you cover?
All 6 official suburbs of the municipality: Hunters Hill, Woolwich, Gladesville, Henley, Huntleys Cove and Huntleys Point. If your street is on the peninsula, we paint it.
Do you paint in Woolwich and Gladesville specifically?
Yes. Woolwich is regular work for us, mostly prestige waterfront exteriors around Woolwich Dock. Gladesville is our busiest local suburb, with full repaints and between-tenant refreshes across period homes and units near the Victoria Road shops.
Can you access narrow streets and tight waterfront blocks?
Yes. A lot of the peninsula has narrow lanes, steep driveways and foreshore homes with limited access. We plan staging, parking and safe setup up front so your neighbours and garden aren’t disrupted, and we sort scaffolding or access equipment where a job needs it.
Do you paint sandstone and rendered facades?
We paint rendered facades and the timber, trim and joinery around sandstone homes. Bare heritage sandstone is often best left unpainted, so we’ll give you honest advice on what should and shouldn’t be coated rather than painting over character stone.
Are you licensed and insured?
Yes, we’re a fully insured painting team and hold Painter Decorator Licence 315254C. We’re happy to share proof of licence and insurance before work starts.
Do you offer free quotes and is there a call-out fee?
Every quote is free and there’s no call-out fee. We measure up, look at prep and access, then give you one fixed written price. No obligation to proceed.
How long does an exterior repaint take?
Most single-home exteriors run from a few days to a couple of weeks, depending on size, surface condition and weather. Heritage homes with heavy timber restoration take longer because the prep is more involved. We give you a realistic timeframe in the quote and keep you posted as we go.
What paint brands do you use?
We use trusted trade-grade brands and match the product to the surface and exposure, for example mould-resistant exterior systems for river-facing homes. If you have a preferred brand or a specific heritage colour range, tell us and we’ll work with it.
Do you do strata and townhouse block painting?
Yes. We handle common areas, riverside blocks and townhouse complexes with clear scopes, tidy staging and coordination with owners or your strata manager. We can work around residents and access schedules.
Do you help with colour selection?
We do. On heritage and streetscape-sensitive homes we’ll talk through period-appropriate schemes and check colours against the house and its surrounds before committing. The goal is a repaint that looks right for the building, not just fresh.
When are you open and how fast can you start?
We’re open 6AM to 6PM Monday to Saturday, closed Sunday. We usually quote within the same week and can often book work soon after. Call 0423 019 087 or send the quote form and we’ll come back within 2 business hours.

Local painters, Hunters Hill peninsula

Repaints built for a heritage peninsula between two rivers

Hunters Hill is not a paint-and-run kind of place. Most of the municipality sits inside a conservation area, and the homes show it: sandstone villas, Federation weatherboards, deep timber verandahs and rendered facades that have weathered a century of river air. Paint that suits here has to respect the building and hold up to the salt and humidity coming off the Lane Cove and Parramatta Rivers.

That is the work we do. Sydney Paintmasters has spent 20+ years painting homes and businesses across Sydney, and on the Hunters Hill peninsula we lean into careful prep, mould-resistant coatings and colours that sit right on older joinery. We turn up when we say we will. We protect your garden, your floors and your foreshore views. And we leave the site clean.

Whether it's a full exterior on a foreshore home in Woolwich, a tidy interior refresh in Gladesville, or strata work on a riverside block, you get one team, one fixed price, and a finish that lasts. No call-out fee. Free quote. Easy to reach.

Suburb by suburb

Painters across the Hunters Hill suburbs

We cover the whole peninsula. Here is what a typical job looks like in each of the main pockets, and where each one sits.

Gladesville 2111

Painters in Gladesville

Gladesville is the largest and busiest of our local suburbs, full of professional homeowners looking after riverside houses and investment properties. Stock is a real mix here: Federation homes, solid interwar brick, and units near the Victoria Road shopping strip. A lot of our Gladesville work is full repaints and between-tenant refreshes booked around busy household schedules.

Typical job: a three-bed interwar home off the shops, walls and ceilings inside, timber windows and eaves prepped and recoated outside, done over a working week.
Get a Gladesville quote →
Woolwich 2110

Painters in Woolwich

Woolwich sits out on the heritage peninsula around Woolwich Dock and Kelly’s Bush, and the homes are premium: prestige waterfront houses with rendered and timber facades that face the weather head on. This is careful, patient exterior work. We spend real time on surface prep and older joinery, then finish in durable coatings that cope with salt air and full sun.

Typical job: a waterfront home exterior, render made good and recoated, timber windows and a period front door restored, colours kept sympathetic to the street.
Get a Woolwich quote →
Henley & Huntleys Cove 2111

Painters in Henley and Huntleys Cove

Henley is a small, quiet riverside pocket where weatherboard Federation homes take the brunt of waterside weathering, so exterior prep and a hard-wearing finish matter most. Huntleys Cove, just along the peninsula, mixes Federation and interwar houses with rendered and timber exteriors that we tend to repaint as full-home jobs. Both are calm streets, and we work them cleanly and quietly.

Typical job: a weatherboard Henley cottage stripped back where needed and recoated, or a Huntleys Cove home refreshed inside and out in one booking.
Get a quote for your street →
Hunters Hill 2110

Painters in Hunters Hill village

The Hunters Hill core is the heart of the conservation area: sandstone, stone walls, mature trees and some of the peninsula’s finest heritage homes. Work here is detail-led and colour-sensitive, from grand exteriors to careful interiors. We also cover Huntleys Point, the small residential point off the Gladesville side, on request. If your street is on the peninsula, we paint it.

Typical job: a heritage exterior on a leafy Hunters Hill street, gentle prep on render and stone-adjacent timber, colours checked against the streetscape before a brush is loaded.

props.label: Faq
props.html:
Answers

Hunters Hill painting FAQs

The questions we hear most from peninsula homeowners and managers.

How much does a painter cost in Hunters Hill?
Repaints here are quoted per job, not per hour. A single room is usually in the low hundreds, while a full interior or a heritage exterior costs more and depends on prep, access and surface condition. Every quote is free with no call-out fee, and the fixed price is locked in before we start. Call 0423 019 087 for a same-week measure-up.
Do you paint heritage and Federation homes?
Yes, that’s core work for us on this peninsula. We handle sandstone-adjacent timber, Federation weatherboard, decorative fretwork and period joinery with gentle prep and colours chosen to suit the era of the house. We keep finishes sympathetic to the streetscape, and we won’t claim heritage approvals we don’t hold.
Can you paint waterfront and foreshore homes exposed to salt air?
Yes. Homes along the Lane Cove and Parramatta Rivers cop humidity, salt-laden air and strong UV. We prep thoroughly and use mould-resistant, weather-rated coatings suited to render, timber, masonry and sandstone so the finish lasts in those conditions.
What suburbs around Hunters Hill do you cover?
All 6 official suburbs of the municipality: Hunters Hill, Woolwich, Gladesville, Henley, Huntleys Cove and Huntleys Point. If your street is on the peninsula, we paint it.
Do you paint in Woolwich and Gladesville specifically?
Yes. Woolwich is regular work for us, mostly prestige waterfront exteriors around Woolwich Dock. Gladesville is our busiest local suburb, with full repaints and between-tenant refreshes across period homes and units near the Victoria Road shops.
Can you access narrow streets and tight waterfront blocks?
Yes. A lot of the peninsula has narrow lanes, steep driveways and foreshore homes with limited access. We plan staging, parking and safe setup up front so your neighbours and garden aren’t disrupted, and we sort scaffolding or access equipment where a job needs it.
Do you paint sandstone and rendered facades?
We paint rendered facades and the timber, trim and joinery around sandstone homes. Bare heritage sandstone is often best left unpainted, so we’ll give you honest advice on what should and shouldn’t be coated rather than painting over character stone.
Are you licensed and insured?
Yes, we’re a fully insured painting team and hold Painter Decorator Licence 315254C. We’re happy to share proof of licence and insurance before work starts.
Do you offer free quotes and is there a call-out fee?
Every quote is free and there’s no call-out fee. We measure up, look at prep and access, then give you one fixed written price. No obligation to proceed.
How long does an exterior repaint take?
Most single-home exteriors run from a few days to a couple of weeks, depending on size, surface condition and weather. Heritage homes with heavy timber restoration take longer because the prep is more involved. We give you a realistic timeframe in the quote and keep you posted as we go.
What paint brands do you use?
We use trusted trade-grade brands and match the product to the surface and exposure, for example mould-resistant exterior systems for river-facing homes. If you have a preferred brand or a specific heritage colour range, tell us and we’ll work with it.
Do you do strata and townhouse block painting?
Yes. We handle common areas, riverside blocks and townhouse complexes with clear scopes, tidy staging and coordination with owners or your strata manager. We can work around residents and access schedules.
Do you help with colour selection?
We do. On heritage and streetscape-sensitive homes we’ll talk through period-appropriate schemes and check colours against the house and its surrounds before committing. The goal is a repaint that looks right for the building, not just fresh.
When are you open and how fast can you start?
We’re open 6AM to 6PM Monday to Saturday, closed Sunday. We usually quote within the same week and can often book work soon after. Call 0423 019 087 or send the quote form and we’ll come back within 2 business hours.
